failureDescription: Document summarization failed when ingested multi-file legal brief exceeded model context window (134,200 tokens).

events.name: llm_generate_executive_summary
events.error: ContextWindowExceededError: Maximum prompt context of 131,072 tokens exceeded. Ingested prompt tokens: 134,200. Request rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

events.name: pipeline_aborted_oversized_payload
events.error: FatalPayloadError: Context window hard limit encountered without map-reduce chunking fallback

hypothesis.title: Context Window Overflow: 134,200 Tokens Ingested
hypothesis.explanation: At evt_503, the agent sent an unchunked 185-page document (134,200 tokens) in a single LLM request, blowing through the 131,072 model limit and triggering HTTP 400.
hypothesis.suggestedFix: Implement map-reduce hierarchical chunking (sliding window of 8,000 tokens) before calling LLM summarizer.
